title.purpose: A tool's name in an index entry.

body.purpose: Prose and inputs; tabular numerals globally; lede in Secondary Ink, max 60ch.

control.purpose: Segments and tiles at 14px, tabs at 15px; buttons use 700 at 15px.

section.purpose: Uppercase fieldset legend in the ticket, Secondary Ink, soft rule above. Never above a heading.

hint.purpose: Help text under a control, max 62ch.

slug.purpose: The proof's slug line; first item bold uppercase 0.04em. Patch captions 650 at 11px.

shadows.purpose: Paper thumbnail in an index entry.

shadows.name: entry-hover
shadows.purpose: Index entry on hover, with ink border.

shadows.name: primary-ring
shadows.purpose: Hover on the black primary button.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out: re-registration, brand-mark hover, entry hover shadow.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border changes on every control.

motion.name: brand-hover
motion.purpose: Registration mark turns magenta on hover.

motion.name: re-register
motion.value: 260ms var(--ease), 20ms stagger, 160ms debounce, offsets (3,-2) (-2.5,2) (1.5,3) px at opacity 0.95 to 0
motion.purpose: Signature: C/M/Y ghosts of the proof marks slip out of register and snap back after the output changes. Not on first render; none under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses every transition and animation.

narrative.overview:
Passer is a press room. The page is a grey room; the form is a white job ticket pinned beside the press; the result is a registered proof sheet, square-cornered paper with crop marks, side registration targets, a colour control strip and a slug line that states the job in plain numbers. Every result is something you check before it goes to print, and the interface is built so that checking is the natural act: input, settings and the current proof sit in one screen, the proof is never behind a button.

The process inks are not decoration. They have jobs: cyan marks focus, magenta marks problems, yellow marks text selection, black marks what is chosen and the one primary action. Everything else is ink on white and grey, ruled with hairlines. One grotesque carries the whole system on a short ramp, with tabular numerals everywhere a measurement appears. Density is a working form's density: 42px controls, 14 to 18px gaps, no ornament between them.

The dark scheme turns the room charcoal and the ticket graphite, but the proof stays paper-white, because the proof shows what will print.
keyCharacteristics: Grey room, white ticket, paper proof: three planes, each with one job.
Process inks as signals (C focus, M problem, Y selection, K choice), never as fills for decoration.
One grotesque (Hanken Grotesk), short ramp, tabular numerals globally.
Square paper, 8px controls: the only sharp corners belong to the proof.
A registration target is the brand mark, the favicon, the app icon and the proof's own furniture.
One signature motion: the proof re-registers on change; everything else is a 150ms state change.

rules.name: The Inks Have Jobs Rule
rules.body: Cyan is focus, magenta is a problem or something needing attention (an app update), yellow is selection, black is the choice. Outside those jobs a process ink appears only on the proof's control strip and registration ghosts, and on the registration mark itself (magenta on hover, the out-of-register ring in the app icon). If a new state needs colour, it takes the ink whose job it is or it stays neutral.

rules.name: The Paper Never Dims Rule
rules.body: The proof sheet and the index's proof thumbnails are paper-white with paper-ink in both schemes. Only the room and the ticket follow the colour scheme.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number a person compares (pixels, modules, centimetres, ratios, dates, hex codes) is set in tabular figures. It is on by default at body level; never turn it off.

rules.name: The Only Paper Casts Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to paper. Ticket controls, the header and the panels stay flat; state is shown with fill, border and ink, never with lift.

dos: **Do** put every tool's result on a proof sheet: paper-white, square, crop marks, side registration targets, control strip and a slug line stating the job's numbers.
**Do** give each process ink only its job: cyan-ink for focus (2px outline), magenta for problems, yellow for text selection, Press Black for the selected option and the single primary action.
**Do** keep the proof paper-white (#ffffff) with #1a1a1a ink in the dark scheme too.
**Do** build choices as segmented ruled bars or ruled tiles with a solid Press Black selected state.
**Do** set every measurement in tabular figures and give numbers their units (px, modules, cm, %).
**Do** keep interface corners at 8px, chips at 5px, paper at 0.
**Do** use dashed 1px borders for "not yet" (empty proof, drop zone, disabled button) instead of fading with opacity.
**Do** draw new icons on the authored 24-unit grid with a 1.75 round-joined stroke.
donts: **Don't** float the output in a rounded "Output" card or a second equal white panel; the result sits on the room as a proof.
**Don't** add shadows to ticket controls, panels or the header; only paper casts.
**Don't** use cyan, magenta or yellow as decorative fills, badges or accents outside their jobs, the control strip and the registration mark.
**Don't** add a second typeface; vary weight within Hanken Grotesk.
**Don't** animate anything but state changes (150ms) and the proof's re-registration; no motion under reduced motion.
**Don't** put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading; small uppercase type is reserved for fieldset section labels and the slug line.
